capabilities: Analyze dream entries with OpenAI models to extract summaries, characters, places, objects, emotions, and symbols
Create and update entity notes with appearance history, related dreams, and duplicate prevention
Find related dreams using combined vector cosine and shared-entity similarity
Generate a dashboard and index notes with journal, lucidity, and emotional trend statistics
Create dream notes from templates with a date picker for historical entries
disambiguation: Not a psychological or medical interpretation tool; it only organizes dream entries and tracks recurring themes.
extras: Installation via the Obsidian Community Plugins directory is listed as upcoming; manual installation from GitHub releases is currently required. The README details exactly which text is sent to OpenAI and states no requests occur without an API key.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to analyze dream journals, extract structured entities from entries, or discover connections and recurring themes between dreams.

relations.evidence: For live interactive tables in the Dashboard and Index pages, installing the Dataview plugin is highly recommended.
This plugin communicates with the OpenAI API (api.openai.com) when you analyze dreams or generate embeddings

summary: AI-assisted dream journaling plugin that analyzes dream entries, extracts entity notes, finds similar dreams, and builds a lucid dreaming dashboard.
